text: aria: Quick convo: where should export & copy actions live when you're viewing a single trace vs a list drilldown? Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234 mike: For single-trace: put meta (corr id/status/duration) left and persistent actions right. In list drilldown we should favor inline tiny actions so row height stays small. devon: Agree. Also consider a sticky export CTA when users multi-select >1 trace. That CTA should surface bulk export + download JSON. olivia: Accessibility note: the copy button needs a clear visual focus ring and an aria-live toast announcing "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". For color, the pill background needs 4.5:1 contrast against the page background. aria: Thoughts on visible label: use "Copy correlation ID" vs icon-only with tooltip? mike: Icon-only saves space but hurts discoverability. Could use icon + short label "Copy ID" on desktop and icon-only on tight mobile width. Tooltip + aria-label required. devon: For keyboard flow: tab order should be: trace title -> corr id -> actions -> kebab. If kebab opens a menu, use arrow keys to navigate and Esc to close. Focus must return to the kebab button after closing. olivia: Also ensure the corr id text is selectable. If we show it as a pill, include an invisible, selectable copy buffer for keyboard users. Example: <button aria-label="Copy correlation ID" data-clip="{id}">Copy ID</button> aria: UX trade: show full corr id inline (long) vs truncated pill with hover reveal. Which do we prototype? mike: Prototype truncated pill in list + full text in the single-trace header. That way list stays compact and detailed view is copy-friendly. devon: Instrumentation: fire events trace.copy_id (props: trace_id, source: list|detail), trace.export_initiated (props: selected_count, format). Also track where users clicked export (sticky CTA vs kebab). olivia: Microcopy for toast: "Correlation ID copied" (role=status, aria-live=polite). For the bulk export CTA label: "Download traces (JSON)". Make sure buttons have focus-visible and 3px minimum target. aria: Action items: 1) aria 12; update figma with list pill + detail full-id + sticky CTA, due Mon. 2) mike 12; create small prototype showing desktop vs mobile label behavior, due Tue. 3) devon 12; analytics spec for trace.copy_id and trace.export_initiated, include source props, due Wed. 4) olivia 12; accessibility checklist (contrast, focus, aria-live) and sample SR announcement copy, due Wed. a11y-bot: Tasks created: D-2031 (List corr-id pill), D-2032 (Detail view id copy), D-2033 (Sticky export CTA) :rocket: aria: Thanks all. I'll post updated mocks and link the prototype once ready. Reopen if anyone sees conflicts with existing patterns.
